meaning:
ἅλλομαι
[in LXX for צָלַח, דָּלַג pi., etc. ;]
to leap: Act.3:8 14:10; of water, to spring up, Jhn.4:14 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing…
Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.
